instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot, eye-level. In an indoor boxing gym with red and black training pads in the background, the male trainer in a gray t-shirt (R1) stands on the left with his back to the camera, holding a black focus mitt. The barefoot woman in a blue hoodie (R2) stands on the right, throwing a fast right punch with her pink glove, creating motion blur. The woman (R2) directs her punch towards the mitt held by the trainer (R1). Bright overhead gym lighting illuminates the action, capturing the dynamic movement on the black floor mats.
